inlines.v: VI'RILE, adjective [Latin virilis, from vir, a man, vireo.] 1. Pertaining to a man, in the eminent sense of the word, [not to man, in the sense of the human race; ] belonging to the male sex; as virile age. 2. Masculine; not puerile or feminine; as virile strength or vigor.
